title: Prevent worker-bundle redeploy from poisoning in-flight change-workflows (Temporal Worker Versioning + deploy-safe rollover)
success_hint: Root prevention for TMPRL1100 poisoning (P2, sibling of Fix poisoned recovery reachability). advance plugin has NO Temporal Worker Versioning (worker.ts Worker.create has no buildId/useVersioning/workerDeploymentOptions) and scripts/deploy-local.sh bounce_deployed_temporal_workers SIGTERM->SIGKILLs the worker at 2s grace mid-replay on every commit touching plugin/src/temporal/. Recent commits (PhasePlan #225) shifted the command sequence between the 4 stable wf.patched() markers in workflows.ts, so in-flight histories fail replay (TMPRL1100). Success: deploy-safe worker rollover — e.g. Temporal Worker Versioning / deployment series so in-flight workflows keep replaying on their original build, and/or drain in-flight WorkflowTasks before terminating the old worker instead of SIGKILL-at-2s. Outcome: redeploying the plugin while changes are mid-flight no longer poisons them. Concentrated in high-volume projects (pokeedge, pokeedge-web).
